author: wolovim
content:
one of my earlier iterations had a "contentious" label on eips that had varying enough opinions, but it felt like the line was always arbitrarily drawn and gave me a little bit of a non-neutral ick. "contentious according to who?"

goal is to know which eips espcially require attention? or would you phrase that differently?

author: robocopsgonemad
content: i think "worth discussion" is how I would frame it

author: robocopsgonemad
content: i.e. a filter to catch non-consensus even beyond the mean.  we can filter harder by the mean if we have that.

author: robocopsgonemad
content: i.e. "DFI everything under 1.3, but hold on, lets talk about these...."

author: robocopsgonemad
content: because we see a lot of emergent consensus in most tiers

author: robocopsgonemad
content: so spend less time on those

author: wolovim
content: good thoughts, thanks. ill play with it.

author: robocopsgonemad
content: i would also use that to order the conversation - it's fine to group them by category, but which category goes first frames the process.
